name: test_add_comm
statement: ∀ n m : Nat, n + m = m + n

name: test_append_length
statement: ∀ l₁ l₂ : List Nat, (l₁ ++ l₂).length = l₁.length + l₂.length

name: test_reverse_reverse
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, l.reverse.reverse = l

name: test_or_comm
statement: ∀ p q : Prop, p ∨ q → q ∨ p

name: test_add_eq_zero_left
statement: ∀ a b : Nat, a + b = 0 → a = 0

name: test_double
statement: ∀ n : Nat, double n = 2 * n
prelude: @[simp] def double : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => double n + 2

name: test_sum_to
statement: ∀ n : Nat, sumTo n * 2 = n * (n + 1)
prelude: @[simp] def sumTo : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => sumTo n + (n+1)

name: test_sum_odd
statement: ∀ n : Nat, sumOdd n = n * n
prelude: @[simp] def sumOdd : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => sumOdd n + (2*n+1)

name: test_sum_sq
statement: ∀ n : Nat, sumSq n * 6 = n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1)
prelude: @[simp] def sumSq : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => sumSq n + (n+1)*(n+1)

name: test_succ_le_two_pow
statement: ∀ n : Nat, n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ n

name: test_sq_mod_four
gold: rcases (by omega : n % 4 = 0 ∨ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3) with h | h | h | h <;> simp [h]

name: test_gcd_succ
statement: ∀ n : Nat, Nat.gcd n (n + 1) = 1

name: test_dvd_mul_right
statement: ∀ m n k : Nat, m ∣ n → m ∣ n * k

name: test_map_double_sum
statement: ∀ xs : List Nat, (xs.map (· * 2)).sum = 2 * xs.sum

name: test_rev_eq_reverse
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, rev l = l.reverse
prelude:
@[simp] def revAux : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat | [], acc => acc | x :: xs, acc => revAux xs (x :: acc)
@[simp] def rev (l : List Nat) : List Nat := revAux l []
gold: have h : ∀ l acc, revAux l acc = l.reverse ++ acc := by intro l; induction l <;> simp_all [revAux]

name: test_fib_mono
statement: ∀ n : Nat, fib n ≤ fib (n + 1)
prelude: @[simp] def fib : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | 1 => 1 | n+2 => fib n + fib (n+1)

name: test_map_map
statement: ∀ (l : List Nat) (f g : Nat → Nat), (l.map f).map g = l.map (g ∘ f)

name: test_mul_self_le
statement: ∀ a b : Nat, a ≤ b → a * a ≤ b * b
